A van travels 80 km using 20 liters of fuel. How many liters are needed for 500 km?
questions.explanation: Fuel per km is proportional. Liters = 500 × 20 ÷ 80 = 125 liters.

questions.question: A van travels 60 km using 15 liters of fuel. How many liters are needed for 300 km?
questions.explanation: Fuel per km is proportional. Liters = 300 × 15 ÷ 60 = 75 liters.

questions.question: A van travels 120 km using 30 liters of fuel. How many liters are needed for 480 km?
questions.explanation: Fuel per km is proportional. Liters = 480 × 30 ÷ 120 = 120 liters.
